definitions.short: Maon , the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H4584. Maon II. מָעוֺן proper name 1. location in Judah Josh 15:55 (P), 1Sam 25:2 ( ᵐ5 Μααν , Μαων ), now Ma`în (Buhl Geogr. 163 and references ), 8 miles south of Hebron; hence מ ׳מִדְבַּר 23:24-25 , (twice in verse), so read also 25:1 (for פארן ᵑ0 ) ᵐ5 Th We Dr Bu Klo Kit Löhr; compare 2. masculine in Judah 1Chr 2:45 (twice in verse), ᵐ5 Μεων , Μαων . 3. of a people Judg 10:12 named with Sidonians and Amalek as ancient foes of Israel; possibly intended by writer as = מְעוּנִים q. v.; many read מִדְיָן ( ᵐ5 B A ᵐ5 L Μαδιαμ ); see GFM. — מְעוֺן see מְעוֺן בַּעַל בֵּית ; 1Chr 4:41 see מְעוּנִים .
